title: RN-7.3-PREVIEW Ledgerline ERP 7.3 Preview Notes (not
summary: Preview notes for Ledgerline ERP 7.3 planned for March 2027, introducing multi-line purchase orders and hard-blocking certificate checks.
body:
Ledgerline ERP 7.3 is a planned future release scheduled for March 2027 and is not installed at any customer as of 26 October 2026 [^r1]. It outlines upcoming functional changes, including multi-line purchase orders and strict validation rules for lithium-cell compliance [^r2][^r3]. None of the features or validations described in these preview notes are currently in force [^r1].

## Changes

Under planned Ledgerline ERP 7.3, screen [[screen-pur-po-01|PUR-PO-01]] introduces true multi-line purchase orders within a single document header, enabling buyers to raise orders containing multiple lines for frames, drive units, switchgear, and ancillary components against a single supplier account [^r3]. Goods receiving in Manchester and Leeds will book in individual lines as deliveries arrive, permitting partial receipts against specific line items, while accounts will match supplier invoices directly to individual lines [^r4].

In planned Ledgerline ERP 7.3, an order for a lithium-cell item will be refused with [[err-sup-0207|ERR-SUP-0207]] when the supplier has no valid [[topic-un-38-3-certificates|UN 38.3 certificate]], replacing warning W-SUP-0207 introduced in 7.2.3-P4 [^r2]. When a buyer adds a battery pack or bare cell line and the certificate record is absent, expired, or rejected, the system returns ERR-SUP-0207, prevents the line from saving, and generates no PO number [^r5]. Senior buyers cannot override this block at order entry [^r5]. Furthermore, a rejected certificate on a single cell line will prevent the entire multi-line document on PUR-PO-01 from saving, even if all mechanical lines on the order are fully compliant [^r6].

## Effect at Northbridge

Because Ledgerline ERP 7.3 is planned for March 2027 and not yet installed, Northbridge continues to operate under existing release functionality as of 26 October 2026 [^r1]. Once implemented, buyers will be able to combine different component categories into consolidated purchase orders on PUR-PO-01, while warehouse staff in Manchester and Leeds will handle partial line-item receipts [^r3][^r4]. However, purchasing teams must ensure valid UN 38.3 supplier certification is recorded prior to order entry, as any certificate failure on a lithium-cell item will halt saving the entire purchase order without exception [^r5][^r6].

## Versions and conflicts

- **Today's rule:** Missing UN 38.3 certificates issue warning W-SUP-0207 under 7.2.3-P4, and Ledgerline ERP 7.3 is not installed as of 26 October 2026 [^r1][^r2].
- **Future rule:** From March 2027, planned Ledgerline ERP 7.3 enforces hard-blocking error ERR-SUP-0207 on lithium-cell lines without a valid certificate, disallowing order entry overrides and blocking the whole document (RN-7.3-PREVIEW) [^r1][^r2][^r5][^r6].
- **Kind:** future_dated
